run_msmarco_eval: run the MSMARCO ranking evaluation script with a reference file and candidate file to compute MRR and pytrec metrics
compute_metrics_msmarco: compute MRR@10 and queries ranked metrics from reference and candidate passage ranking dictionaries
load_reference_msmarco: load reference relevant passages from a TSV file into a query ID to passage IDs mapping
load_candidate_msmarco: load candidate ranked passages from a TSV or JSON file into a query ID to ranked passage list mapping
quality_checks_qids: perform quality checks on reference and candidate dictionaries to detect duplicate passage rankings per query
